preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line.split()), list) and len(line.split()) > 0 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() != '')
preconditions.description: Every non-empty line in stdin is a space-separated list of integers, representing either group sizes or friend lists.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit())
preconditions.description: Every group size (digit-only line) is between 1 and 100 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(friend) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit() for friend in line.split())
preconditions.description: Every friend label in a friend list is between 1 and 100 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(friend not in line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit() for friend in line.split())
preconditions.description: No friend appears in their own friend list (no self-loops).

preconditions.expression: all(len(friends) >= 1 for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit() for friends in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Every friend has at least one friend in their group.

preconditions.expression: all(any(friend in group_friends for friend in group_friends) for group_friends in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: The friend graph in each group is connected (every friend can reach every other friend via friend links).

postconditions.description: For each group, stdout contains the most popular friend label (smallest label in case of ties) and their average distance from all friends in the group (rounded to 6 decimal places).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(friend) <= 100 for friend in stdout.split()[0])
postconditions.description: The most popular friend label is a valid integer between 1 and 100.
The average distance is a non-negative float (distance cannot exceed 100 for groups of size <= 100).

postconditions.expression: (lambda group: any(all(1 <= int(f) <= 100 for f in group) and all(f not in group for f in group) and len(group) >= 1 and any(f in group for f in group) for group in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()]))(stdin)
postconditions.description: The most popular friend is chosen from the group's friends, and their average distance is computed as the mean of all pairwise distances (including self-distance 0) in the group.

postconditions.expression: (lambda group: any(all(1 <= int(f) <= 100 for f in group) and all(f not in group for f in group) and len(group) >= 1 and any(f in group for f in group) for group in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()]))(stdin) and (lambda group: any(all(1 <= int(f) <= 100 for f in group) and all(f not in group for f in group) and len(group) >= 1 and any(f in group for f in group) for group in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()]))(stdin)
postconditions.description: The most popular friend is the one with the smallest average distance (notoriety) in their group. In case of ties, the smallest label is chosen.
